sources.title: Etablissement du juste prix de vente
sources.supports: To determine market value the broker must carry out a comparative analysis with similar properties recently sold in the same sector, and give a well-founded, reasoned opinion; factors: location, dimensions, year built, state of upkeep, number of rooms and layout, materials, landscaping, market characteristics.

sources.title: Ordre des evaluateurs agrees du Quebec
sources.supports: 'L'evaluateur agree formule une opinion objective et motivee sur la valeur d'un bien ou d'un droit immobilier. Il procede a l'examen methodique du marche immobilier et genere un rapport d'evaluation.'

sources.title: Evaluateurs agrees, evaluatrices agreees (12203.001)
sources.supports: Membership in the OEAQ is required to use the title evaluateur agree.

sources.title: evaluateur agree, Grand dictionnaire terminologique
sources.publisher: Office quebecois de la langue francaise
sources.supports: In Quebec the title evaluateur agree is granted by the OEAQ, governed by the Professional Code.

sources.title: Laval: Statistiques immobilieres, Centris.ca
sources.supports: Laval, 3rd quarter 2026, median price: single-family $630,000, condominium $439,999. Median definition: half of transactions below, half above.

sources.title: Droits de mutation immobiliere, Ville de Laval
sources.supports: The comparative factor brings the roll amount to market value; 1.032 for 2026.

sources.title: Code de l'estimateur
sources.supports: Method described on the page; example Laval condo 900 sq ft, 2 bd, 2 ba, 1990s, average, exterior parking, no basement: 390 x 900 = 351,000; range 0.85 / 1.15 rounded to thousands = 298,000 to 404,000.

claims_needing_review: Calculator code (already documented in the code, decision of 2026-10-02): coefficients have no published source. With the same code, Laval detached 1,600 sq ft, 3 bd, 2 ba, 1990s, average, 1-car garage, finished basement gives about $919,000 against a Centris Q3 2026 single-family median of $630,000. The page now shows the Centris medians next to the method so the reader can calibrate.

Wording rule applied: the result is never called an evaluation/appraisal; the broker's product is a 'valeur marchande estimee' from an ACM; only an evaluateur agree (OEAQ) produces an appraisal report.
